name: manual_f5a313
claim: When multiple sessions concurrently change infrastructure-critical hooks or guard scripts, use one append-only coordination board. Record status before and after consequential steps, reread the board before acting, and treat the latest timestamped ruling as authoritative when live verification changes an earlier understanding.

decisions.notes: The shared board redirected an ownership-boundary mistake, surfaced a review finding before follow-up work began, and let independent sessions fix separate defects without clobbering commits or bypassing verification.

rationale: The shared board redirected an ownership-boundary mistake, surfaced a review finding before follow-up work began, and let independent sessions fix separate defects without clobbering commits or bypassing verification.
